text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein allocates 50 million dinars for construction of country roads in southern Iraq.
- Ship loaded with 25,000 tonnes of wheat anchors at Umm Qasr and more ships laden with cooking oil will arrive soon.
- Iranian Kurd exiles capture Tehran agents who poisoned more than 80 of their fighters.
- BBC says more than 25 countries hold talks with Iraq for the future development of oilfields.
- Iraqi pilgrims in Mecca are safe and sound.
- Iraqi Endowment and Religious Affairs Minister arrives in Mecca.
(The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ and JUMHOURIYA)
- Commentary says presence of foreign troops in Gulf and spending billions on weapons will not protect rulers of Kuwait.
- United States bugs headquarters of an Iraqi delegation in Vienna.
- British newspapers say oil deal with Russia to dismantle the embargo on Iraq.
